title: ESS Uniform Invasion Barrier
body_html:
ESS Uniform Invasion Barrier

For an evolutionarily stable strategy $p$, the invasion threshold can be chosen uniformly over all mutants: there is $\epsilon_0>0$ such that every $q\ne p$ is beaten for every $\epsilon\in(0,\epsilon_0)$.

Equivalently, there is a neighborhood $V(p)$ such that $$ pAq>qAq \quad\text{for every }q\in V(p),\ q\ne p. $$

This local form is the bridge from the static ESS condition to stability under the replicator dynamics.

References

  • [MFoGT, Chapter 5, Proposition 5.5.8] Laraki, Renault, and Sorin, Mathematical Foundations of Game Theory, references/MechDesign.pdf. Uniform threshold and local neighborhood characterizations of ESS.
